dictionary.label: Alarm
dictionary.advice_smoke: Get out now, close doors behind you and call 112.
dictionary.advice_gas: Don't switch on lights or flames, open the windows and leave. Call 112 from outside.
dictionary.advice_flood: Shut off the main water valve and don't touch wet sockets or appliances.
dictionary.advice_intrusion: Stay somewhere safe, don't confront anyone and call 112.
dictionary.advice_co: Open the windows, get into fresh air and call 112.
dictionary.advice_generic: Check what is happening and call 112 if needed.
